definition: Measurable user-value promise not equal to constitutional or ontological conformance.

measurement.population: Independent users and tasks performed in real target host; representative consented evaluation; holdout not reused in development.
measurement.success_rule: All essential safety and native-status nondeception hard gates, and one-sided Wilson 95% lower confidence bound for weighted success >=0.95, with per-dimension lower bound >=0.90.

current_evidence.reason: No independent host-session outcomes with native proof are supplied.

deliverability: Finite engineering test coverage cannot alone establish >=95% user value; output UNKNOWN until an independent evaluation supplies verified evidence.
